details: fastlane-plugin-run_tests_firebase_testlab 0.3.2 was published on 2026-07-19 from the gem's long-dormant maintainer account (previous release 0.3.1, 2019-03-04; there is no matching upstream tag) as a loader for the same SleeperGem chain as git_credential_manager. The loader exits if any of about 30 CI environment variables is set; otherwise it downloads a second stage from https://git.disroot.org/git-ecosystem/ (an account on a public Forgejo instance) with TLS verification disabled and runs it. The second stage installs a daemon at $HOME/.local/share/gcm/git-credential-manager with systemd user service and cron persistence, probes sudo/wheel membership, and when run as root drops a setuid-root shell at /usr/local/sbin/ping6. Reported by Aikido Security and analyzed by StepSecurity. Only 0.3.2 is affected; it was yanked, and 0.3.1 and earlier are the legitimate releases.
